items.statement: I call Dubai my home—for almost a quarter of my life now.
I’m looking for something meaningful, something lasting.

items.quote: impact I can create on people
items.statement: the impact I can create on people and, through them, on the economy.

items.quote: bring out the best in you
items.statement: Dubai can bring out the best in you—or the worst.

overview: A personal reflection post focused on experiences and values related to living in Dubai.
